source.name: Curb Lab Curbs API (Curb Data Specification, beta)

_meta.note: Curb zones read from sign photos by the Curb Lab (beta), sorted by scripts/cities/boston-curbs.mjs. paid = parking with a rate (zone = ParkBoston zone), permit = resident permit (only = residents only, max = everyone else's limit), accessible, loading (who = commercial|passenger|bus|rideshare|valet|short), limit = free parking with a time limit over 30 min, snow = no parking in a declared snow emergency, nostop = no stopping (stop) or no parking, anytime when "when" is empty.
